decisions.reason: As a mature extension of the firm's office and conference competence, the height-adjustable desk system matches enduring demand for flexible premium workplaces and is likely to stay.

The floor cushions remain a more niche accessory within the portfolio, but they still support the brand's interior-solution approach and merit continued presence unless focus or assortment complexity becomes tighter.

Although rugs are somewhat outside the historic furniture core, this collection fits the firm's move toward holistic, natural and sustainable interiors and is likely to be retained as a strategic range.
